description: A controller class for managing IP-based fraud extension in the Opencart admin panel. The file contains methods for rendering the IP management interface, saving settings, installing/uninstalling the extension, listing IPs, and adding/removing IPs for fraud detection.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Controller class for IP-based fraud management in OpenCart admin, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main IP management page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language, config, and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the extension settings for IP-based fraud detection, ensuring user has permission.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of the IP fraud extension if user has permission.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of the IP fraud extension if user has permission.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Loads the IP list view for managing blocked IPs.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of IP addresses flagged for fraud and renders the IP list view.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to the fraud list after validation and permission checks.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the fraud list after permission check.
